title: 第二十三章 山庄聚会第二十四章 周白筠
content_zh:
翌日，周六。
王腾难得起了个晚，八点多才睁开眼睛。
窗外的阳光照射进来，落在脸上，让他不禁抬手挡住，适应了一下。
“唔，八点四十五分了。”
王腾看了下时间，起床刷牙洗脸，然后走下楼。
家里的佣人陈姨，李姨已经在工作了，陈姨扫地，李姨擦灰尘。
别墅大是大，就是做卫生麻烦，光靠自己做卫生，明显不现实。
“起来了，快来吃早饭吧。”
李秀梅看到他，说道。
“妈，我睡过头了，怎么也不叫我一声。”
王腾说道。
“我看你那么累，所以就没叫你，反正是周六，也不差这一两个小时。”
李秀梅道。
“小少爷变了很多，现在越来越勤奋了。”
李姨笑了下道。
陈姨和李姨虽然是佣人，但和他们一个家人都相处的不错，以前王腾再纨绔，对她们也没有任何不尊重的地方。
这一点，要归功于王盛国的严厉，以及李秀梅的品性教育。
有什么样的父母，就有什么样的孩子。
“听说小少爷正在练武，我家那儿子以前也去练过，可惜没有天赋，最后只能放弃了，毕竟练武对我们普通人家来说负担太重了。”
陈姨也附和的说道。

“你们啊，就别夸他了，不然这尾巴就要翘到天上去了。”
李秀梅笑道。
王腾一边吃早餐，一边和李姨她们聊了几句。
顺带回了下昨晚白薇和余浩发的微信。
吃完早餐，他对李秀梅说了一声，就开车出门去了。
极星武馆，武徒训练大楼二层。
王腾和几个相熟的学员打了声招呼。
“阿腾，今天来的有点迟啊！”
张少洋停下练拳，擦了擦额头的汗，看样子已经训练了个把小时了。
“睡过头了，我妈也不叫我。”
王腾无奈道。
“哈哈哈，天下妈妈都一样，我要是睡过头，我妈也是从来不叫我。”
content_en:
The next day, Saturday.
Wang Teng rarely woke up late and didn't open his eyes until after eight o'clock.
The sunlight outside the window shone in and fell on his face, causing him to raise his hands to block it and get used to it.
"Well, it's eight forty-five."
Wang Teng checked the time, got up, brushed his teeth and washed his face, and then walked downstairs.
The domestic servants Aunt Chen and Aunt Li are already at work. Aunt Chen sweeps the floor and Aunt Li wipes the dust.
The villa is big, but cleaning is troublesome. It is obviously unrealistic to just do the cleaning by yourself.
"Get up, come and have breakfast."
Li Xiumei saw him and said.
"Mom, I overslept and you didn't even call me."
Wang Teng said.
"I saw you were so tired, so I didn't call you. It's Saturday anyway, so it won't be less than an hour or two."
Li Xiumei said.
"The young master has changed a lot and is becoming more and more diligent now."
Aunt Li smiled and said.
Although Aunt Chen and Aunt Li were servants, they got along well with their family members. No matter how dandy Wang Teng was in the past, he had no disrespect towards them.
This is due to Wang Shengguo's strictness and Li Xiumei's character education.
What kind of parents are there, what kind of children are there.
"I heard that the young master is practicing martial arts. My son has also practiced martial arts before, but unfortunately he has no talent, so he had to give up in the end. After all, martial arts training is too heavy a burden for ordinary people like us."
Aunt Chen also echoed.
"You guys, please stop praising him, otherwise his tail will rise to the sky."
Li Xiumei smiled.
Wang Teng chatted with Aunt Li and the others while eating breakfast.
By the way, I brought back the WeChat messages sent by Bai Wei and Yu Hao last night.
After breakfast, he said something to Li Xiumei and drove out.
Ji Xing Martial Arts Hall, the second floor of the martial arts training building.
Wang Teng said hello to several familiar students.
"Ateng, you're a little late today!"
Zhang Shaoyang stopped practicing boxing and wiped the sweat from his forehead. It looked like he had been training for an hour.
"I overslept and my mother didn't call me."
Wang Teng said helplessly.
"Hahaha, mothers are the same all over the world. If I oversleep, my mother will never call me."
